planets.name: TOI-411 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 22946 with a 4.04-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-411 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 22946. Its orbit and size follow Garai et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
